name: todo-life-dashboard
description: A clean, minimal client-side dashboard aggregating a greeting, a 25-minute focus timer, a to-do list, and quick links. Plain HTML, a single CSS file, and a single Vanilla JavaScript ES module, with all state persisted in Local Storage. Test tooling (Vitest + fast-check + happy-dom) is dev-only and does not alter the production artifacts in css/ and js/.
